model_annotation: The figure presents two line plots illustrating training rewards over steps for different reinforcement learning agents. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500 with tick intervals of 50, and the y-axis, labeled “Training Rewards,” ranges from 0 to 0.4 with tick intervals of 0.05. The top plot shows three lines: a solid black line representing “Llama-On-Policy-Easy,” a solid red line representing “Llama-LUFFY-Easy,” and a dashed cyan line representing the shaded area indicating the standard deviation of “Llama-On-Policy-Easy.” At the beginning of the x-axis, the black line is approximately at 0.3, and at the end it is approximately at 0.35; the red line begins at approximately 0.2 and reaches approximately 0.38; and the cyan line fluctuates around these values. The bottom plot shows a single line, a solid red line representing “Llama-LUFFY-Hard,” which starts at approximately 0.0 and increases to approximately 0.12 over the range of 0 to 450.
